Professional Summary
Seasoned sales and business development professional with a strong blend of revenue-generation, client relationship management, and data-driven analysis. Track record of driving B2B sales, improving CRM/SFDC pipeline hygiene, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to close enterprise deals and optimize processes.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, SFDC, CRM, Negotiation, SQL, Python, Agile, Jira

Senior Business Development Manager, Kite Learning (Jun 2019 - Present)
- Managed enterprise B2B Sales cycles using SFDC and CRM workflows to increase average deal size by 28% and reduce sales cycle time by 18%.
- Led renewal and upsell programs tracked in SFDC, improving customer retention rates through targeted outreach and negotiation strategies.
- Collaborated with product and customer success teams in Agile ceremonies and Jira-tracked sprints to define packaging and pricing improvements that drove a 22% revenue uplift.

Business Development Manager, HCLTech (Mar 2019 - May 2019)
- Supported strategic account pursuits leveraging Salesforce and CRM dashboards to prioritize opportunities and streamline lead-to-opportunity conversion.
- Conducted stakeholder negotiations for pilot engagements, securing multi-quarter PoCs and converting 40% into paid engagements through tailored commercial terms.
- Coordinated with delivery and proposal teams in an Agile setup, using Jira to track requirements and accelerate proposal turnaround.

Sales Manager, Accenture (Sep 2018 - Feb 2019)
- Drove B2B Sales initiatives for vertical accounts, maintaining pipeline accuracy in Salesforce and ensuring CRM data quality for forecasting.
- Executed commercial negotiations for enterprise contracts, closing deals with improved margin through structured concession strategies.
- Worked closely with cross-functional teams to translate client requirements into Jira tickets and Agile backlogs for rapid delivery alignment.

Business Analyst, Pixelwave Studios (Oct 2014 - Aug 2018)
- Performed data analysis using SQL and Python to generate insights on user behavior and monetization, informing product roadmap decisions.
- Built automated reports and dashboards integrated with CRM exports to support sales and marketing campaigns and improve lead segmentation.
- Participated in Agile sprint planning and tracked tasks in Jira to ensure timely delivery of analytics and reporting features.
